turns.text:
can you edit my reply to my teammate, too long and kinda preachy lol. her text:

"hey!! practice run is sat right? who's covering which slides for the nov 8 competition? i have market sizing + recs done but i'm gonna pull an all nighter tn to finish the risk slide"

my draft:

hey yeah practice run is sat. i got the logistics cost section, so market sizing and recs are yours, risk slide can be split if u want. pls don't pull an all nighter for it, go to sleep, it's not worth it and ur gonna be useless for case comp if u crash. i'll be up around 2 anyway so if u need anything just text me. fyi i'll reply after 8 tonight, trick-or-treaters keep hitting our door lol

Here's a tighter, friendlier version:

"Hey! Yep, practice run is Saturday. I've got the logistics cost section, so market sizing and recs stay with you. Happy to split the risk slide, send me whatever's rough and I'll take half. Please don't pull an all-nighter on it, you'll be sharper for case comp if you sleep. I'll be online around 2 a.m. anyway if you need anything. I'll reply after 8 tonight, trick-or-treaters keep showing up at my door!"

Changes: I cut the "useless if you crash" line since it can read as a dig, turned the risk slide split into a concrete offer, and kept the tone casual. Want a shorter two-line version too?
th 2nd one pls, tldr. and put in that i can take th risk slide intro

Short version:

"Practice run's Saturday! I've got logistics cost, you've got market sizing + recs. I'll take the risk slide intro, send me what you have. Please sleep, I'm online around 2 a.m. if you need anything. I'll reply after 8, trick-or-treaters at my door!"
